thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: network-degraded - azure centralindia (centralindia) - vpn/bgp route oscillation impacting Redwood Private clusters connected via customer VPN/ExpressRoute. Severity: P1. Pager: @maria oncall.

maria: getting paged — seeing alerts for packet loss and route flaps for multiple private subnets peered to centralindia. Customers using Private deployments reporting intermittent timeouts and failed API calls.

ashwin: I can see BGP state flapping on our edge routers (peer 10.20.0.1). Observed ~20s up/down intervals. Flows to onprem through vpn-gw are getting rerouted — some traffic shows 100% packet loss during flaps.

devon: tagging impacted customers: corp-fin, analytics-team. Both have onprem VPNs into centralindia. telemetry shows increased 5xx from private endpoints in India region.

maria: runbook step1: confirm provider incident and open support case if not already. Ashwin — can you grab traceroute + bgp summary from edge? put here.

ashwin: paste of quick checks:
```
# show bgp neighbors summary
Neighbor        V    AS MsgRcv MsgSent   TblVer  InQ OutQ Up/Down  State/PfxRcd
10.20.0.1       4  65515  12345  12340        5    0    0 00:03:21  Idle (flapping)
10.20.0.2       4  65515  23456  23456        5    0    0 12:12:05  Established  128
```
traceroute to 10.0.5.1 (customer gateway) shows multiple hops timing out during the flap windows.
```
 1  edge-1 (10.1.1.1)  0.6 ms 0.4 ms 0.5 ms
 2  azure-gw (10.1.254.1)  * * *
 3  ...
```

ellie: I’m seeing DNS resolution inconsistencies from the private DNS zone attached to centralindia -> some queries fail, some succeed depending on which egress path is used. Could be tied to routing churn.

maria: opening Azure support ticket now. Case: 12048292. Noted provider region-level network team onstandby. Linking support case: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/..../supportCase/12048292

azure-support-bot: Support case 12048292 created. Initial ack from Azure network team. Investigating BGP session resets seen in centralindia POP.

devon: mitigation plan: 1) spin up temporary cross-region peering to southeastasia for critical corp-fin traffic, 2) enable policy-based fallback in our smart-router to route private requests to dedicated region for healthcheck failures, 3) keep customers informed.

ashwin: implemented temporary route advertisement to southeastasia (which has spare capacity). Pushed config:
```
vrouter route-map FAILOVER permit 10
 set community 65535:100
```
Traffic for prefix 10.0.0.0/22 now prefers southeastasia path. Monitoring now.

chris: heads-up — this will increase egress latency for affected customers ~80–120ms, but will reduce errors. Please post the communication snippet I should send to corp-fin.

maria: draft to corp-fin:
"We're seeing network instability in Azure Central India affecting Private VPN paths. We've temporarily rerouted your traffic through SEA region to restore connectivity; latency may be higher. We're coordinating with Azure for root cause and will update within 30m."

priya: ACK. I'll send to the customer now and notify support channel.

azure-support-bot: Azure update: observed intermittent maintenance activity on an internal fabric switch in centralindia causing BGP session resets for a subset of customers. Engineers applying mitigations; ETA 25m for stabilization.

ellie: after failover, error rate for private endpoints dropped from 12% -> 0.8%. Latency median increased from 15ms -> 105ms for impacted flows. Metrics stored on dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/az-net/centralindia

maria: oncall handoff timeline — I'm active for another 18 minutes. If unresolved by 17:12 UTC I'll hand to @ashwin. Current mitigation is holding.

ashwin: taking over now (handing accountability). I'll keep paging Azure and coordinate rollback when stable.

ashwin: Azure reports a patch applied; BGP sessions are showing longer uptime. I see neighbors Established again across the board. Running a 10m stabilization watch.

devon: can we start rolling back the temporary route after 10m stable? Need planned rollback steps logged.

ashwin: rollback plan:
- validate 10m BGP stability and DNS consistency
- remove route-map FAILOVER and withdraw SEA advertisement
- monitor for customer errors for 30m

chris: please alert if error rate rises >1% post-rollback. I'll have support page on standby to revert if needed.

azure-support-bot: Azure confirms fabric switch mitigation complete. No further maintenance planned for at least 72h.

ashwin: proceeding to withdraw the temporary advertisement now.

ashwin: withdrawal complete. Re-adsorption to centralindia path confirmed. Running post-rollback checks.

ellie: DNS check pass, queries resolve consistently. No TTL anomalies observed.

maria: updating incident status: mitigated — customer traffic restored to normal paths, error rates back to baseline. Affected customers: corp-fin, analytics-team. Impact window ~00:28:00.

priya: customer notifications sent. corp-fin support acknowledged and ok with higher latency during failover, then confirmed service normal after rollback.

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: network-degraded - azure centralindia. Resolution summary: transient fabric switch issue caused BGP resets; temporary cross-region routing mitigated customer impact; Azure applied fabric-level fix. Postmortem required.

maria: filing postmortem on this thread. Assigning action items: (1) automate failover for Private VPN healthchecks (owner: devex), (2) add provider maintenance detectors (owner: eng-infra), (3) document rollback playbook (owner: eng-sre). I'll create GH tasks.

ashwin: note for postmortem — capture BGP flapping patterns + edge configs, include kenel counters and tcpdump from edge during incident window.

chris: thanks team. good job on the quick failover and customer comms. :thumbsup:
